summary: Prototype pollution through front matter keys
details: With frontMatter: true, a front matter key named __proto__ or constructor.prototype was merged into the options object, so a document could change defaults for later renders in the same process. Only 3.0.0 to 3.0.4 parse front matter this way.

affectedWhen: the documents come from people you do not trust
one process renders documents from several users
notAffectedWhen: frontMatter is false or unset (the default)
every render runs in a fresh process or worker
workarounds: set frontMatter: false and parse front matter yourself with a safe parser
desk.vexHint: not_affected with vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path when frontMatter is off
